description: This file defines a function to build a database query for a scatter plot chart using Deck.gl in the Superset visualization platform. It handles spatial data, metrics, and tooltip configurations, constructing a query context with appropriate columns, metrics, filters, and ordering.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Constructs a query object based on form data, including spatial columns, metrics, filters, and ordering, for rendering a scatter plot chart.
